title: 5-State Feature & Permission Lifecycle Walkthrough
intro: See how all 490 catalog permissions flow from compile-time definition into active tenant pools, pickers, persistent roles, and live enforcement—while isolating 69 PlatformOnly and 32 disabled-module permissions.
outro: Disabling a feature revokes Effective access immediately while preserving RolePermissions intact for clean re-enablement.

points.title: Compile-Time Definition & Entitlements Resolution
points.text: All 490 permissions across 19 providers carry explicit feature predicates or IsGloballyAvailable; EffectiveFeatureMapBuilder admits 389 active permissions for scripe-internal.
points.caption: State 01 -> 02: Edition + Override unlocks 389 SCRIPE perms

points.title: Assignable Tenant Filtering
points.text: PermissionsController and RolesController filter to !PlatformOnly and active TenantPermissions, preventing unavailable or platform-host actions from appearing in UI pickers.
points.caption: State 02 -> 03: API returns only eligible tenant permissions

points.title: 16 Roles & 10 UserGroups Assignment
points.text: Admins bind permissions into the 16 seeded RBAC roles with Priority ordering and dotted UserGroupRestrictions persisted in IdentityDbContext.
points.caption: State 03 -> 04: Grants & FLS rules persisted

points.title: Live Effective Authorization
points.text: At request time, PermissionAuthorizationHandler combines PBAC, PAT scope intersection, live IFeatureChecker, and multi-role FLS merge.
points.caption: State 04 -> 05: Enforced on live API & export execution

points.title: 69 PlatformOnly Permissions Quarantined
points.text: 69 host-only permissions never enter TenantPermissions, tenant UI pickers, Break-Glass elevation, or MembershipMode execution.
points.caption: Exit X1: Zero tenant leakage of platform-host operations

points.title: Toggle Off & Restore Without Data Loss
points.text: Turning a feature override off removes Effective access and updates T_SCRIPE_SA immediately, yet leaves custom RolePermission rows intact so re-enabling restores prior roles.
points.caption: State X2 <-> 02: Non-destructive toggle loop

points.title: Commit -> Bump Principal Version Stamp
points.text: Every role, group, or override mutation evicts AdminPermissionCache and bumps principal version stamps post-commit before returning fresh Effective sets.
points.caption: State X3: Zero 30-second stale cache window

points.title: Fail-Closed 403 Refusal
points.text: Stale tokens, PAT scope mismatches, restricted FLS writes, or unreachable HttpFeatureChecker immediately return 403 Forbidden.
points.caption: Exit X4: Safe fail-closed security guarantee
